name: Guan Chao Holdings Limited
summary: Guan Chao Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the sale of parallel-import and pre-owned motor vehicles in Singapore and internationally. It also provides motor vehicle financing, motor vehicle insurance agency, and motor vehicle leasing services; and sales of motor vehicle spare parts and accessories. In addition, it engages in sales of hair-care products; and manufactures and sales lithium niobate crystals and lithium niobate thin films. Guan Chao Holdings Limited was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Singapore.
